title: bind.ws connection template
description: One app shortcut for a relay's Connect fold: the app, what it does with this relay, and the links that hand a viewer over to it. Links carry {relay:*}, {owner:*}, {user:*} and {input:*} placeholders the relay fills in. The relay's parser (src/connections.ts) is the last word; this schema is for the editor.

title.description: what the shortcut is for, in the owner's words: Repos, Notes, Photo library

about.description: one sentence on what opens and what it does with this relay

app.description: the app the shortcut hands over to

where.description: where the app runs: web, phone, iPhone, Android, desktop, terminal

feature.description: the shortcut is shown only while this feature is on

visibility.description: who sees the shortcut when the owner adds it without saying: anyone, anyone signed in, members, the owner

href.description: a link to open: https://, or nostr: for the viewer's own app

copy.description: text to put on the clipboard instead of a link

qr.description: what the QR code carries; the first link's href when left out

default.description: the value when the owner leaves it blank

pattern.description: a regular expression the owner's value must match; a value that lands in a URL path or a shell command names one
